about: The cat roams: petted, it goes up to the attic no exit reaches a minute later, the world never opening, and comes back down a minute after that; the kitchen hears it go and come. Nudged, it cannot carry the hay up: roaming takes the cat anywhere, and nothing it moves, so that move faults.

expect.words: The cat purrs, and eyes the ceiling.

expect.text: kitchen.cat woke, 60 seconds after it asked

expect.words: A cat leaves for an attic.

expect.text: kitchen.cat woke, 60 seconds after it asked

expect.words: A cat arrives from an attic.
Something in this world has gone wrong, and nothing has changed.

expect.text: the command faulted, against attic, MoveFault: `roaming.attic` is out of range of `roaming.kitchen.cat`, so nothing could be moved into it.
